context: Evaluates correct usage of the Vendure package's `fetcher` export, focusing on environment variable resolution order (NEXT_PUBLIC_VENDURE_LOCAL_URL before NEXT_PUBLIC_VENDURE_SHOP_API_URL), correct request format including credentials and Content-Type, and proper error handling using FetcherError.

checklist.name: Import fetcher
checklist.description: The solution imports the `fetcher` directly from `@vercel/commerce-vendure` (via the package's exports) rather than implementing a custom fetch function.

checklist.name: LOCAL_URL priority
checklist.description: The solution correctly demonstrates that `NEXT_PUBLIC_VENDURE_LOCAL_URL` takes priority over `NEXT_PUBLIC_VENDURE_SHOP_API_URL` when both are set.

checklist.name: Missing URL error
checklist.description: When neither environment variable is set, calling the fetcher throws an error (not silently fails), indicating the Shop API URL has not been provided.

checklist.name: FetcherError on failure
checklist.description: The fetcher throws a `FetcherError` (from `@vercel/commerce/utils/errors`) rather than a plain Error when the API returns errors or a non-OK response.

checklist.name: credentials: include
checklist.description: The fetcher is used in a context that relies on `credentials: 'include'` being part of the request, enabling Vendure's session-cookie-based auth to work.
